<skill name="code-review" description="Strict Pydantic JSON schema code review playbook for identifying race conditions, memory leaks, and architectural boundary violations.">
  <guidelines>
    # Enterprise Code Review Playbook (Codex / GPT Edition)

## Rules of Engagement
1. **Unidirectional Architecture**: Ensure no domain agent imports `sqlalchemy`, `models`, or `database`.
2. **Deterministic Typing**: Ensure all function signatures have explicit Python 3.12 type annotations.
3. **Fail-Closed Security**: Verify all external URLs are sanitized by `validate_outbound_url` before fetching.
4. Output findings strictly matching the `CodeReviewVerdict` Pydantic model.
  </guidelines>
  <examples>
    <example title="Direct DB Import Detection">
      <input>Review diff adding SQLAlchemy select in agent reasoning handler</input>
      <expected_output>Flagged architectural violation (SEC-P0-01); recommended routing via MemoryService.</expected_output>
    </example>
  </examples>
</skill>
